races.drawBiasExplanation: Low draws advantaged around tight polytrack bends

verdict.comment: A few open to improvement, headed by SO SASSY, who shaped nicely in all three runs last backend. Handle With Care is second choice.

comments.alcazan: The return to sprinting will help but she hasn't offered much in two runs back
comments.baileysjubilation: Easier course again won't hurt under an experienced 5lb claimer; is shortlisted
comments.beautifulthings: Has gone the wrong way for this yard, hanging left throughout last time
comments.commendation: The race didn't pan out her way last time and she won't mind going back up to 6f
comments.handlewithcare: Progressed with racing last summer and is entitled to have come on for Kempton fourth
comments.sosassy: Showed enough last autumn to warrant consideration, especially with Oisin Murphy booked
comments.spiritualism: Blinkers return, having been left off for her low-key comeback; ought to fare better
comments.toughly: Pleasing handicap/Polytrack debut behind Handle With Care last time; open to improvement

races.raceComment: alcazan is marginally preferred with a score of 45.3%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form over spiritualism. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The vote goes to CRAFTER whose record over C&D reads 21242. Another big run appears likely.

comments.coolree: 2lb below last winning mark, but 0-10 on the AW so he does need to find a bit more
comments.crafter: Record over C&D reads 21242; another big effort seems likely
comments.ellexis: C&D winner off 1lb lower in January; respected back here; cheekpieces on
comments.etretat: 2lb higher than when winning over C&D in January, but below form lately and drawn widest
comments.foreseen: Won in France and second at Newmarket in November, but poor since; others preferred
comments.imperialcult: Won twice over 1m4f here last year; off five months but can go well fresh; considered
comments.mollyvalentine: Ended a 13-race losing run at Wolverhampton in December, but well held there last time
comments.newfangled: Fine form in cheekpieces in second half of 2024, but off five months and no headgear today
comments.obsidianknight: Four-time winner over 1m2f around here; had excuses last time; shortlisted
comments.princerasam: Lightly raced since winning sole start at two; back from another absence; plenty to prove
comments.risenagain: Placed five times but now 0-11 and not progressing; blinkers on

races.raceComment: newfangled is marginally preferred with a score of 53.8%, holding clear edges in superior course form over ellexis. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 3 wins from 4 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance, though returning from absence and step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: A chance is taken with FAT GLADIATOR despite only having raced ten times since May 2021. His recent return suggests the ablity remains.

comments.fatgladiator: Has only raced ten times in almost four years, but the ability remains; interesting
comments.francesi: C&D winner, but just 1-32 and he may need a stiffer test than this now
comments.lincolnlegacy: 3-11 for previous yard but tailed off on stable debut 12 days ago; enough to prove
comments.loveyourwork: 4lb higher then when winning at Chelmsford last time; no surprise if he again goes well
comments.masterofgreygoose: 0-7 but has made the frame five times and may still may have a bigger performance in him
comments.mistermojito: Probably needed last month's Kempton return having been gelded and undergone wind surgery
comments.rabinal: Best form has come here, but his record in Class 5 handicaps or higher reads 5864097
comments.riveralwen: Didn't seem suited by the drop to 1m at Chelmsford last time and this is even sharper
comments.saturnalia: Has been running consistently well in defeat lately, but a losing run of 15 is a concern
comments.southkensington: 0-8 and lightly raced since autumn 2023; best watched unless the market suggests otherwise
comments.taskheer: Dual C&D winner, but finished behind a couple of these at Chelmsford last time

races.raceComment: rabinal is marginally preferred with a score of 52.5%. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include optimal distance, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Low draws advantaged around tight polytrack bends

verdict.comment: There will always be risks with ASHFORD HILL but this company is softer than she's faced of late. Seas Of Elzaam is feared most.

comments.alyara: Needs to settle better; does most racing over further and has never found winning easy
comments.ashfordhill: Pulled hard from the outside stall here last time and is capable back at this lower level
comments.bluecollarlad: Returns from a break on a career-low mark having struggled in three runs in the winter
comments.kessaarpower: Likes Chelmsford and will be happier back on Polytrack but needs to bounce back
comments.lorddanielson: Patchy record at best at beyond 6f; stall 10 isn't ideal for one happiest on the sharp end
comments.mountmogan: Landed a third course win when last seen in January; more on his plate off this mark
comments.repartee: Useful in his day but is inconsistent and poor now; again only holds outside claims
comments.royaljet: Handicapper quick to ease off but a first-time hood will need to make a difference
comments.seasofelzaam: Doesn't always find as much as looks likely but he'll rightly be popular once more
comments.yarayah: Maiden who hung left a few times for Sean Woods; has been gelded and the market will guide

races.raceComment: alyara is marginally preferred with a score of 52.4%, holding clear edges in more reliable profile over mountmogan. Placed in 1 of last 6 starts, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: This might be set up for COMEDIAN LEADER off a career-low mark. Galel will find this easier and she's worth a look too.

comments.beartodream: Two fair efforts back from a break, without much luck, and an easy 7f is fine; considered
comments.comedianleader: Could well have this set up for her if she gets the breaks from a wide stall; player
comments.edergolesgift: The blinkers come off and, despite a further 3lb drop, she's hard to make a case for
comments.galel: This easy 7f down to 0-55 company for the first time looks ideal; watch the market
comments.mashaan: Previous C&D winner who arrives in form; remains consistent and a case could be made
comments.neptunelegend: Has enjoyed a consistent start to the year and looks set to go well once more
comments.outreach: AW wins have come at Wolverhampton and he's high in the weights now
comments.porfin: Has run poorly a few times since forced out of 0-50 company; has other pace around him
comments.ravensbourne: Has run well here before and is drawn to attack but others make more appeal
comments.regalglory: Had plenty of chances in weak races; only holds each-way claims

races.raceComment: neptunelegend is marginally preferred with a score of 52.1%, holding clear edges in better ratings over outreach. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Likely to be steadily run with pressure on the leader, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: The vote goes to GALLANT who hasn't been seen since winning at Kempton in October, but the form of that race has worked out very well.

comments.donpacifico: Off the mark at Southwell in December, but he may need a stiffer test than this now

comments.hellozaman: Won a C&D novice with plenty of authority in January; this is harder but still respected
comments.luzonprince: Unraced for Godolphin; this looks a hot race in which to make his debut
comments.maury: Faces a daunting task in this field on debut
comments.pureimagination: Well beaten on debut; handicaps over further should suit in due course
comments.sassysprezzatura: Out the back in both starts at Kempton last summer; no appeal

races.drawBiasExplanation: Low draws advantaged around tight polytrack bends

verdict.comment: This is open but perhaps COSMIC VIEW can add to his recent Wolverhampton win over National Health and Walk The Moon.

comments.avarice: Has C&D form; shaped as if retaining ability latest; of interest dropped to a classified
comments.cosmicview: Chequered career but has C&D form and off the mark over 1m4f at Wolverhampton latest
comments.deesdream: 0-13 on AW but useful 1m4f third at Newcastle in January and she acts on Polytrack
comments.emperordream: Had very few chances but his form needs a boost on these unfavourable terms
comments.foinix: Two 1m4f classified wins on turf in August; first run at this level since; can be involved
comments.honrado: Claims on 1m4f form here and on turf in 2024; ahead of Largo Bay over C&D in January
comments.largobay: Four course wins; excuses for recent defeats; cheekpieces refitted; thereabouts
comments.misueno: Two hurdle wins last spring but has gone off the rails since, including on turf/AW
comments.nasim: Has run well at 1m3f in better races than this; trip query upped to 1m4f; classified debut
comments.nationalhealth: Maiden; several good AW runs of late, 2nd to Cosmic View in February; path blocked latest
comments.sapphiresirocco: Lightly raced; poorly positioned when well adrift here latest; probably capable of better
comments.walkthemoon: Solid Tapeta form this year but dropped out in sole Polytrack run, over C&D last summer

races.raceComment: largobay is marginally preferred with a score of 50.3%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions over foinix. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.brinton: Consistent since returned to AW; slight stamina doubt, but should stay on this sharp track
comments.crazymaisie: Hasn't shown any worthwhile form in over a year; hard to fancy
comments.danehillstar: C&D winner, but he has finished behind Brinton on all three occasions they have met
comments.iftikhaar: Now 0-27 and has the widest draw
comments.laurentia: Six AW wins including three here; needs a good pace to run at, but she may well get it
comments.mrtrick: Each-way claims on form, but a record of 3-53 means that others are preferred for the win
comments.polesapart: From a respected stable, but now 0-13 and stamina a big question over this far
comments.roundaboutsilver: Only once made the frame in seven starts on the AW; still has to prove he wants this far
comments.theormergatherer: 0-18 under rules and has only been placed once; hard to make a case for him
comments.venusslipper: Made it 14th-time lucky in a 0-55 handicap over C&D last month; ought to go well again
comments.werenotreallyhere: Drops to this level for the first time, but latest efforts raise doubts

verdict.comment: The vote goes to the resurgent RAFT UP, who made it 2-2 in a hood when completing a Newcastle double 18 days ago.

comments.papadontpreach: Has ordinary strike-rate but he's gone close over C&D and at Chelmsford in last two runs
comments.radiantangel: Made his breakthrough over C&D last month and a 3lb rise looks fair; shortlisted
comments.raftup: Made it 2-2 in a hood when completing a Newcastle double 18 days ago; big player again

comments.shamardia: Clear second at Chelmsford and has claims if she can back that up off an unchanged mark
comments.southbank: Won at Chelmsford in December and he had a tough task there last time; in the mix

races.raceComment: raftup is marginally preferred with a score of 53.7%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over heartrate. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

races.raceComment: paradoxical is marginally preferred with a score of 64.2%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form over hitched. Won 4 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 6 wins from 13 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 6/18 at wolverhampton. Key attributes include optimal distance and positive comments, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
